title: Qwen3-TTS codec: cache fixed codebooks and retain request-owned causal state
summary: Avoid repeated codec normalization and history reconstruction under fixed evaluation weights; preserve per-request convolution and attention state.

hardware: Ascend 910B1 source campaign; other devices require independent qualification
software: InferMatrixLab/qwen3-tts-engine source snapshot; consult source evidence for measured revisions
conditions: Frozen evaluation weights and a stable model/device/dtype for the cache lifetime.
Streaming decoder semantics and history window must match the reference model.

claims.description: CachedQuantizer materializes normalized codebooks once and preserves the sequential residual-quantizer accumulation order.
IncrementalCodec retains causal convolution history and attention cache; CodecSlots supplies separate arena indices and frame positions for active streams.
Optional Snake constants and a BF16 contiguous Triton activation path are present. Their presence does not establish an isolated speedup.

downstream_impact: vLLM-Omni: cache immutable codebook normalization inside the owning decoder; retain its existing stream ownership instead of copying the standalone scheduler.
A downstream cache needs explicit invalidation on weight reload, device/dtype conversion and training; the standalone fixed-weight helper is not a general reload-safe module.
recommendations: Treat each mechanism as a separate transfer experiment; do not multiply isolated or combined-stack gains.
validation_plan: Compare quantizer and waveform outputs over multiple chunk partitions, first/last chunks and residual-codebook counts.
Interleave streams, cancel/reuse slots, poison old history and replay graph buffers to detect cross-request leakage.
Measure eager and captured activation paths separately; keep unfused fallback if fusion regresses.
limitations: The source helper assumes immutable evaluation weights and does not implement general cache invalidation.
Codec fusion can lose to eager execution for some shapes; do not infer an operator gain from whole-engine throughput.
Imported source guidance only; no InferRSI accelerator, audio-quality or end-to-end reproduction.
